Every one of the round's six lines is confirmed with the checker's own evidence; the gates are green (install, lint with
its probe-red check, build, `landed:verify`; NEAR at full strength red only on `repins.test.ts`' two cells of other
stages, all 15 enceinte files green; RELATED@1000 red only on those two and a third cell of S1's, each the declared
shift of another item's round); the refusal census does not rise (the 122 S3 runs commit, a 19-seed sample outside e-06's S3 lists still
commits, the S5 class falls to the anchor rung's seeds, typed and pinned verbatim). No new finding is a blocker; nine
notes (N-64 – N-72) go to `checks/M0-c-02-notes.md`.

**The earlier seat's F1 is withdrawn as a failing line (it is note N-71).** The draft of 2026-11-09 carried one blocker,
"a gate is red in the item's own file at reduced strength": `PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000 corepack pnpm exec vitest run
packages/layout/test/enceinte/s5seeds.test.ts` exits 1 ("No test found in suite F-WALL's later rungs (M1) …": the
second `describe` loops over `FULL ? LATER_RUNGS : []`). That command is real and still exits 1, but it is not a gate:
the draft expected the red in RELATED@1000 and the finished run does not show it —

* `related1000.log` (the tree, 2026-11-09 20:57 – 23:16, gate (3)'s command over the round's five sources): "Test Files
  2 failed | 254 passed (256) / Tests 3 failed | 3241 passed (3244)", no "Failed Suites" block; the two failed files are

* `chain2/related-list.json` (the same command, collect only): the 256 selected files include
  `packages/layout/test/enceinte/s5seeds.test.ts` (3 tests at reduced strength), every suite "passed";
* the mechanism: `vitest related` sets `passWithNoTests` unless the command line gives it
  (`node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/cac.DfDGTQ9W.js:2336` `argv.passWithNoTests ??= true`, over
  `vitest.config.ts:26`'s `false`), and the runner fails an empty suite only without it
